blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Arbitrum block 484220930, the DUSD proxy resolves to verified RealWorldAssetTether implementation 0xe825f4f14b93a329fbae230ef6b222f26cca4028. Its blacklist mapping and removeFromWhitelist() prevent re-whitelisting and thereby mint/redeem eligibility, while pause() gates mint, redeem, and releasePendingRedeem. The verified implementation does not override ERC-20 transfer or transferFrom and contains no blacklist or pause hook on holder-to-holder transfers. Re-verified at Arbitrum block 489415741 (2026-07-30): the proxy EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots, the offchainTreasuryOracle binding, and the oracle offchainSigner are unchanged and paused() returned false, so the code-level findings continue to hold. Possible is retained because the current V9 status vocabulary cannot separately encode eligibility censorship without asserting a holder-transfer freeze.
